_purpose: Ratchet baselines for the donor audits. Each number is the highest problem count that was true and recorded at the stated date. A run that produces MORE problems than this baseline fails; producing fewer requires lowering the baseline in the same change, so donor drift cannot be re-introduced silently.
donor_gate_note: eng/check-donor-sources.py --local-only: 17 issues across 36 bindings, all 'no app-local source tree' for declared-but-never-vendored donors that carry no aspirational annotation (Write/Present/Data LibreOffice, GStreamer/GES, glycin/loupe, libvterm, eds/libical, llama.cpp source, Wine, WinBoat, gnome-shell, mutter, Code-OSS/VSCodium). None comes from a pin. Avalonia passes as a framework-scope donor via recorded fork equivalence rather than a gitlink. 12 aspirational bindings are reported separately and are not counted as issues.
census_note: eng/development/donor_policy.py census: 29 donor rows, 0 violations, 6 findings. Findings are recorded drift (Rnote patches absent from the consumed pin, fork not consumed yet, Avalonia and Files as loose vendored trees) and stay visible in the log.
coverage_note: eng/development/donor_coverage.py audit: 28 specification designations over 31 declared donors, against 31 distinct registry bindings (36 bindings). 9 problems remain, all of one class: registry bindings the specification's own wording does not designate - code-oss, vscodium (bound to an app key 'Dev' while the specification names VS Code/VSCodium/Code - OSS nowhere, 0 matches, and says Build is one application), eds and libical (Planner's section says it is first-party with 'No external application donor is currently normative'), and glycin, loupe, gstreamer, ges, libvterm (no designation sentence found). Each is an owner decision, not something I resolved by editing the registry.
coverage_note_history: 26 -> 24 problems: Avalonia declared as a framework-scope donor with a blob-level fork-equivalence receipt (3,027/3,027 identical), resolving its two designations. 24 -> 9 problems: the 12 designated donors the registry never mentioned are now declared as explicitly aspirational (no source, no pin, licence state recorded as measured or UNVERIFIED), and two legitimate non-submodule verification modes were recorded (files: imported source verified by tree hashes; llama-cpp: pinned prebuilt binary). Nothing was vendored, pinned or integrated to obtain this drop - the count fell because the specification's designations are now declared in the registry, which is what the audit checks. The aspirational class is recorded as 14 audit notes and 12 gate notes naming the outstanding work, so the debt stays visible at the row level rather than only in a total.
